_comment: Source images for the music visualizer (generate_visualizer_images.py). Every prompt gets `style` appended; the black background is keyed out to transparency afterwards, so only the glowing subject melts into the presets. Change a seed to re-roll one image.
style: Centered single subject, glowing with its own light, vivid saturated colors, high contrast, isolated on a pure solid black background, nothing else in the frame, generous black margin around the subject, no text, no watermark, no border.
negative: text, letters, watermark, signature, frame, border, gray background, gradient background, floor, ground, horizon, multiple subjects, blurry, low quality

images.name: nebula_eye
images.prompt: A single realistic human eye seen from the front, with eyelids and lashes, its iris a swirling nebula of magenta, teal and gold stars around a black pupil.

images.name: jellyfish
images.prompt: A bioluminescent jellyfish with long trailing tentacles, glowing cyan and violet, translucent bell.

images.name: neon_lotus
images.prompt: A lotus flower drawn in glowing neon tubes, pink petals and electric blue outlines.

images.name: fire_koi
images.prompt: A koi fish made of liquid fire and molten gold, curling as it swims, embers trailing from its fins.

images.name: mandala
images.prompt: A symmetrical mandala of thin glowing geometric lines, rainbow spectrum colors, intricate and radial.

images.name: crystal_skull
images.prompt: A human skull carved from clear crystal, splitting light into rainbow prism rays.

images.name: hummingbird
images.prompt: A hummingbird mid-flight with iridescent emerald and violet feathers, wings blurred with light.

images.name: ringed_planet
images.prompt: A ringed gas giant planet with bands of orange and turquoise, glowing rings tilted toward the viewer.

images.name: stained_butterfly
images.prompt: A butterfly with stained glass wings lit from behind, jewel-toned panes of ruby, sapphire and amber.

images.name: psychedelic_sun
images.prompt: A retro psychedelic sun with a calm smiling face and wavy rays in orange, magenta and yellow.

images.name: glowing_orb_hands
images.prompt: Two open hands cupping a glowing orb of swirling plasma, light spilling between the fingers.

images.name: neon_windmill
images.prompt: An old prairie windmill outlined in glowing neon light, warm amber blades and a teal tower.
